name: Image Viewer
description: View images stored in the VFS. Supports PNG, JPG, WebP, and other browser-renderable formats.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: File Explorer
description: Full-featured file explorer with context menus, drag-and-drop, and file operations.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: Terminal
description: xterm.js-powered terminal with tabbed sessions, shell commands, and VFS access.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: Settings
description: System settings and preferences — wallpaper, layout, window manager, widgets, keybindings, and storage.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: App Drawer
description: Full-screen app launcher with pinned apps, recent history, and category browsing.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: App Manager
description: Install and manage apps from registries. Supports custom registry URLs with per-app install/uninstall.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: Spotlight Search
description: Global search overlay triggered by Ctrl+K / Cmd+K. Searches apps, commands, and VFS files.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: SQLite Browser
description: Browse and query SQLite .db files stored in the VFS. Powered by sql.js (WASM).
author: bootstrapper-js

name: NN IDE
description: Neural network IDE for designing and training models visually in the browser.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: WAMP Client
description: WebSocket Application Messaging Protocol client for real-time pub/sub and RPC.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: SQLite Charts
description: Query SQLite databases and visualize data with bar, pie, and line charts. Add chart widgets to the desktop.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: Audio Player
description: Music player for audio files stored in the VFS. Supports MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, M4A, AAC, and Opus. Playlist, shuffle, repeat, and seek controls.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: Colleps
description: Wave Function Collapse generator. Define tile/block adjacency rules with a live editor and generate procedural 2D grids or 3D voxel structures.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: TrainBoard
description: TensorBoard-style metrics dashboard. Log loss, accuracy and any scalar from Python; line charts update live with smoothing and multi-run support.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: Model Builder
description: Visual neural network model builder. Assemble layers, pick datasets (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST), and train in-browser with live loss charts.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: Snake
description: Classic Snake game built with canvas. Use arrow keys to play.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: Snake AI (LSTM)
description: Snake game with an LSTM neural network agent that learns to play autonomously.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: Snake AI (Q-Learning)
description: Snake game with a Q-Learning reinforcement learning agent trained in the browser.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: Snake AI (Conv3D)
description: Snake game with a 3D convolutional neural network agent that trains entirely in the browser.
author: bootstrapper-js

name: App Launcher
description: Compact app launcher overlay for quickly opening registered apps and commands.
author: bootstrapper-js
